yoast_head_json.title: Giving Them A Chance - Kids Under Cover
yoast_head_json.description: Safe housing key to reducing youth justice involvement, new report finds. A new report from Kids Under Cover and Swinburne University of Technology has A new report from Kids Under Cover and Swinburne University of Technology has found that stable, supported housing can play a critical role in reducing youth justice involvement and helping young people reconnect with education, training and employment. The report, Giving them a chance, highlights the impact of the Kids Under Cover Studio Program, showing that early intervention and safe housing — paired with the right support services — can help break cycles of homelessness, disadvantage and justice system involvement while delivering better outcomes for young people and the broader community.
